messages:
devon: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need a slim runbook (top-of-page fast triage) + owners for remediation items. Focus: triage commands, escalation ladder, and recurring-pattern alerts. Claim items pls.

jen_sre: I'll draft the one-page fast triage + pasteable CLI snippets. Aim to post a PR in 48h.

chris_platform: I'll own the pre-deploy guard (admission webhook) and add a /healthz?cache endpoint returning eviction_rate. Prototype next week.

maria_pm: I'll write acceptance criteria and the short CS comms blurb if we enable fallback routing.

ian_product: I'll prioritize the rollout and sync with sales/CS.

jen_sre: Draft snippet for runbook header to include:
```
# Fast triage (0-15m)
1) confirm eviction spike: kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --since=20m | grep -i eviction
2) check affected pods: kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --sort-by=.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount
3) run health check: curl -fsS https://runtime.internal/healthz?cache=stats
4) soft-fallback: curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/admin/routing -d '{"policy":"fallback-low-ram","selector":"model:XYZ"}'
```

devon: Escalation ladder proposal: oncall -> senior runtime (10m) -> runtime lead (25m) -> infra pager (60m). Incident doc opened within 10m. Agree?

maria_pm: Agree. Add a quick rollback play for quant/compile changes: `redwood-ctl versions rollback --model MODEL --to VERSION` + `kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime -n inference`.

opsbot: Created ticket <https://tracker.redwood.local/RED-4999|RED-4999> "Fast-runbook + remediation ownership" assigned to jen_sre. Monitor created: eviction_rate > 0.005 over 10m -> infra-sre pager.

devon: Nice. I'll bundle these into a 2-week remediation sprint after owners confirm due dates. Reconvene here in 48h to close the runbook. If blocked ping me or @chris_platform.
